panels.title: Big questions
points: Why is potassium stored under oil but gold found as a shiny metal in the ground?

panels.title: Islamic foundation
panels.text: Allah says: 'And We sent down iron, in which is great strength and benefits for people' (al-Hadid 57:25). Knowing why iron rusts and how to protect it is part of using that benefit wisely.

panels.title: Mg + CuSO₄ → MgSO₄ + Cu. Identify what is oxidised and reduced. [2 marks]
points: Mg loses electrons to form Mg²⁺: oxidised
Cu²⁺ gains electrons to form Cu: reduced
Answer: Magnesium oxidised; copper ions reduced
